name: notch
title: Notch
description: A capsule pinned near the screen edge with grouped settings; each group opens into a short list of choices and the bar shows the current value for every group.
use: A reading app or dashboard needs a few global settings always reachable without a full menu.
avoid: It pins over page content, so on small screens it can cover text unless you leave room at the edge.
a11y: Triggers always report aria-expanded false even when open, and there is no focus ring or arrow-key handling. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded capsule floats low on a near-black article page, split by dotted dividers into three items, each with a small icon plus a label and current value. Opening one raises a narrow panel of rounded option rows.
behaves: Tapping a group expands the pill upward into a list with a spring and blur, the active row filled indigo with a dot. Choosing closes it and updates the bar; clicking outside or pressing Escape dismisses it.
customise: Feed an items array of groups and options, and set position, align, offset, accentColor, showSelectedValue, showDividers and closeOnSelect; styling is in the source.
weight: light: A small fixed bar with one layout spring and short option animations.
